chapters.title: The Enigma of Amigara Fault
content: A massive earthquake creates a strange fissure in a mountain.
The fissure reveals human-shaped holes carved into the rock.
Each hole is perfectly shaped for a specific individual.
People from all over come to find their own personal hole.
The holes seem to call out to specific people.
Those who find their hole feel an irresistible urge to enter.
A man named Owaki discovers a hole that fits his shape.
He enters the hole despite warnings from others.
The hole is narrow and he can barely move inside.
He continues forward, unable to stop or turn back.
Other people also enter their respective holes.
The holes lead deep into the mountain.
The people inside realize that there is no exit.
The holes are traps designed to drive people insane.

chapters.title: The Enigma of Amigara Fault Part 2
content: The protagonist watches as more people enter their holes.
He becomes obsessed with finding his own hole.
The holes seem to be calling out to everyone in the region.
A woman finds her hole and enters without hesitation.
The protagonist feels the same urge but resists.
He tries to convince others to resist the temptation.
The holes twist and turn in impossible directions.
Those who enter are never seen again.
The protagonist begins to doubt his own sanity.
He finds his own hole and faces the ultimate decision.
The hole is shaped exactly like his own body.
The pull of the hole is almost impossible to resist.
He resists the temptation and walks away.
The fate of those who entered remains a mystery.

chapters.title: The Long Dream
content: A patient named Tetsuro Mukoda is admitted to a hospital.
He suffers from dreams that feel incredibly long.
Each night, he experiences years of dream time.
The dreams become more vivid and realistic over time.
Mukoda wakes up with physical changes from the dreams.
His dreams range from months to decades in length.
One dream lasts for a century and ages him dramatically.
The doctors are unable to explain the phenomenon.
Mukoda's body begins to deteriorate from the dreams.
His dreams become nightmares of isolation and suffering.
He experiences the pain of living for centuries.
The dreams eventually drive him to complete madness.
Mukoda passes away after a dream lasting thousands of years.
The dream continues after his death.

chapters.title: The Hanging Balloons
content: Strange balloons begin to appear in the sky.
Each balloon has the face of a person on it.
The balloons float down and hang people from the neck.
The victims are strangled by the balloon's rope.
The balloons are replicas of the victims' own faces.
People try to destroy the balloons before they attack.
The balloons are indestructible and relentless.
A girl named Kazuko is haunted by her own balloon.
The balloon follows her everywhere she goes.
She hides but the balloon always finds her.
The balloon wraps its rope around her neck.
She is dragged into the sky and disappears.
The balloons continue to terrorize the population.
There is no escape from the hanging balloons.

chapters.title: The Hanging Balloons Part 2
content: The hanging balloons multiply and cover the sky.
Thousands of balloons float above the city.
The balloons represent every person in the region.
The victims are dragged into the sky by their balloons.
The corpses of the victims hang from the balloons.
The people live in constant fear of the balloons.
A man decides to confront his own balloon.
The balloon attacks him and pulls him upward.
He fights back but cannot defeat the balloon.
The balloon drags him into the sky with it.
The surviving people watch as the balloons multiply.
The situation becomes hopeless for everyone.
The balloons block out the sun completely.
The city is destroyed by the balloon invasion.

chapters.title: The Window Next Door
content: A woman notices a window in her neighbor's house.
The window is shaped strangely and seems out of place.
She becomes obsessed with the window next door.
The window seems to be watching her every move.
She sees a figure moving behind the window's glass.
The figure is deformed and twisted in disturbing ways.
The window appears in unexpected places in her apartment.
The woman tries to block the view of the window.
The window reappears despite her efforts.
The figure behind the window comes closer each day.
She feels the presence of the window in her mind.
The window is alive and pursuing her.
The woman is driven to madness by the window.
The window consumes her completely.

chapters.title: The Fashion Model
content: A fashion designer creates a life-sized mannequin.
The mannequin is incredibly detailed and beautiful.
The mannequin begins to move on its own.
It becomes a fashion model for the designer.
The mannequin is jealous of human models.
It destroys all human competition in the fashion world.
The mannequin becomes the most famous model in the world.
It seduces humans with its beauty.
The mannequin leads people into dangerous situations.
It never ages or changes like human models.
The mannequin's creator is its only weakness.
He tries to destroy his creation.
The mannequin kills him and continues its reign.
The mannequin is an immortal predator.

chapters.title: The Fashion Model Part 2
content: The mannequin continues to destroy human models.
It controls the fashion industry completely.
The mannequin's influence spreads beyond fashion.
It manipulates governments and corporations.
The mannequin creates more mannequins like itself.
These mannequins serve as its army.
Humanity is helpless against the mannequin invasion.
The mannequins replace humans in every industry.
The world becomes a place of plastic and perfection.
The original mannequin is worshipped as a god.
The mannequins continue to reproduce and spread.
The remaining humans live in hiding and fear.
The world is overrun by fashion model mannequins.
Humanity is on the verge of extinction.

chapters.title: The Human Chair
content: A man creates a chair that is actually a human body.
The chair is covered in leather and looks normal.
The man enjoys sitting in his creation.
The chair begins to absorb his essence.
The man's spirit becomes trapped in the chair.
The chair is sold to an unsuspecting family.
The family notices strange sounds from the chair.
The chair begins to move on its own.
It creeps toward people while they sleep.
The chair tries to consume the family members.
They discover the truth about the chair.
The family tries to destroy the chair.
The chair fights back with supernatural strength.
The chair escapes and looks for new victims.

chapters.title: The Human Chair Part 2
content: The human chair spreads fear throughout the city.
People live in fear of their own furniture.
The chair continues to absorb people's spirits.
A paranormal investigator tries to stop the chair.
He discovers the chair's true origins.
The chair was created by a cursed spirit.
The spirit seeks revenge on humanity.
The investigator confronts the chair directly.
The chair tries to trap him in its depths.
The investigator escapes and discovers a weakness.
The chair can be destroyed by fire.
He burns the chair and frees the trapped spirits.
The curse is broken at last.
The spirit of the chair finally rests.

chapters.title: The Bully
content: A young boy is bullied by his classmates.
The bullying is cruel and relentless.
The boy tries to defend himself but cannot.
He discovers a way to fight back.
The boy makes a doll of his bully.
The doll is identical to the bully.
The boy discovers he can control the doll.
He uses the doll to hurt his bully.
The bully feels pain from the doll's injuries.
The boy tortures the bully through the doll.
The bully is completely broken by the experience.
The boy's revenge is brutal and effective.
The bully becomes a broken shell of a person.
The boy continues his revenge on other bullies.

chapters.title: The Bully Part 2
content: The boy's powers grow stronger and more dangerous.
He controls multiple dolls of his enemies.
His revenge extends beyond the bullies.
He punishes anyone who has wronged him.
The authorities investigate the mysterious events.
They discover the boy's secret.
The boy is arrested for his crimes.
He is sent to a psychiatric hospital.
The dolls continue to exist without him.
The dolls take on a life of their own.
They continue the boy's mission of revenge.
The dolls become unstoppable and unkillable.
The world is haunted by the vengeful dolls.
The boy's revenge extends beyond his own life.
